notes: Factory interval annual / 10,000 mi for both eras (987.1 M96/M97 and 987.2 9A1 DFI). Given the cars' age most owners shorten to 5,000-7,500 mi. Use Porsche A40-approved 0W-40.
The general annual service (minor/'A' service). Applies to all 987.1 and 987.2 model years. Intervals are cumulative - the 2yr/4yr services include the annual items.
Every 2 years regardless of mileage (fluid is hygroscopic). All 987.1/987.2, manual/Tiptronic/PDK. Use DOT 4 (later cars DOT 4 Low Viscosity).
Inspect pad and rotor wear at each annual service; replace on wear. Applies to all 987 years.
Part of the minor/intermediate (2yr) service. Applies to all 987.1 and 987.2.
Part of the 2yr service. Applies to all 987.1 and 987.2.

987.1 only (M96/M97, 2005-2008). Six plugs. NOTE: the official 987.1 checklists (PNA 000 162 EC/ED/EE, 2008) specify 36,000 mi / 4 years - treat 36k as the authoritative 987.1 figure; the 40k shown here matches Porsche's later 2009 (987.2) schedule (PNA 000 162 EH). Either way the 4-year time limit is firm. Replace even on low-mileage cars to avoid seizing in the alloy head.
987.2 only (9A1 DFI, 2009-2012). Six plugs. Factory 4yr / 40,000 mi. DFI engines are sensitive to plug condition (cold-start/misfire), so keep to the 4-year limit even at low mileage.
Inspect spark-plug tube seals for oil seepage whenever plugs are changed (~4yr/40k). Weeping seals are common on M96/M97 (987.1). Applies to all 987; inspection only, replace on leakage.

No factory drain/refill interval - Porsche G40 is a lifetime fill. Inspect condition/level at each service; common owner practice is a fresh drain-and-refill every ~4-6 years (interval shown is that owner practice, LOW confidence as factory value). System must be vacuum-filled / properly bled to avoid air pockets. Use G40 (silicate-free).

Inspect at each service; replace around 6yr / 60k. Official cadence: CHECK the poly-V drive belt at 40k/100k/160k mi (2009 987.2 schedule PNA 000 162 EH) or 36k/84k/132k mi (2008 987.1 checklists), and REPLACE it at 60,000 mi / 6 years (LO 03 83 00). Applies to all 987.1 and 987.2.
At about 6yr / 60k. Applies to all 987 years.

Manual cars only (both 987.1 and 987.2). Factory 12yr / 120k. The mid-engine transaxle integrates the differential, so this one fill covers the diff - there is no separate diff service on manual cars. Use 75W-90 GL-5. Many owners change earlier (~60k).
Manual cars only. The hydraulic clutch shares the brake reservoir / DOT 4 fluid and is bled during the 2-year brake fluid flush - no separate interval.

task: Tiptronic S automatic transmission fluid (ATF) service
notes: 987.1 Tiptronic S only (ZF 5HP19 5-speed auto, 2005-2008). Porsche markets this as a lifetime/'fill-for-life' fluid for normal use, but the official 2008 checklists (PNA 000 162 EC/EE) DO schedule a Tiptronic ATF + ATF-filter change at 108,000 mi / 12 years. Specialists and owners strongly recommend an interim service every ~4-6yr / 40-60k (the 60k/6yr interval shown reflects that specialist recommendation, MEDIUM confidence). A drain-and-fill only recovers ~3.5 L because the torque converter retains the rest. Use ZF Lifeguard 5 ATF.

987.1 Tiptronic only. On the auto the final drive is SEPARATE from the ATF (~0.8 L of 75W-90). There is no drain plug - old oil is suctioned out and refilled via the fill plug. The official 2008 Porsche checklists (PNA 000 162 EC/EE) schedule this final-drive oil change at 108,000 mi / 12 years, alongside the Tiptronic ATF + filter service.

987.2 PDK only (2009-2012). Factory PDK gear oil + filter interval is 12yr / 120k, but specialists and owners strongly recommend ~40k / 4yr to protect the Mechatronic unit. Requires PIWIS-guided fill procedure.
987.2 PDK only. Separate from the PDK gear oil. Factory cadence 6yr / 60k; many specialists do it earlier (~40k) with the transmission service. Requires PIWIS fill mode.

No fixed interval. Check for the latest Porsche PIWIS transmission software / applicable TSBs at major services - updates can resolve PDK shift-quality and Tiptronic adaptation complaints. 987.2 PDK and 987.1 Tiptronic. LOW confidence (as-needed, not a scheduled item).

task: DFI fuel-system check (no serviceable fuel filter)
notes: 987.2 9A1 DFI only. There is NO scheduled/serviceable fuel filter - the filter is integrated in the in-tank pump module (lifetime). The camshaft-driven high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP) is a known wear item; not a scheduled service, but inspect if you see rough hot-starts, misfires or fuel-trim/pressure faults. LOW confidence (condition-based, not interval-based).

Inspect tread, age (replace ~6yr regardless of tread) and pressures at every service. All 987 run staggered fitment, so front-to-rear rotation is not possible; rotate side-to-side only if directional pattern allows.
987 ships with a tyre mobility (sealant) kit instead of a spare. The sealant bottle expires and is a listed replacement item at ~4yr / 40k. All 987 years.
Load/CCA-tested at each annual service. All 987 years. A trickle/maintenance charger is recommended for low-use cars.

No fixed factory A/C service interval. Operation and vent temperature are checked at scheduled services; recharge R134a and service the receiver/drier only as needed (interval shown is a practical check cadence, LOW confidence). All 987 years.

Porsche's official 'Minor Maintenance' operation (Labor Operation 03 24 00), due every 12,000 mi / 1 year on the 987.1 (mileage cadence 12k/48k/84k/120k; time cadence 1/4/7/10 yr). Scope: read fault memory & reset the service-interval indicator, change engine oil & filter, replace the pollen/cabin filter, check coolant level & antifreeze, and a full visual inspection of leaks, coolant hoses, radiators/air intakes, brake pads/discs/hoses/lines, drive-shaft boots, tyres, body drains, lighting and battery, plus a road test. The engine air-filter element is NOT part of the minor service (renewed at the major service). On the 987.2 (2009-2012) Porsche instead schedules the oil change every 10k mi/1yr with the larger 'Maintenance' items at 40k/4yr. Recent Porsche literature widened some Boxster minor intervals to 20k mi/2yr - defer to the owner's manual.
source: Porsche PNA 000 162 EC — 987/997 Minor Maintenance Checklist (LO 03 24 00, Edition 11/07)

notes: Porsche's official 'Major Maintenance' operation (Labor Operation 03 26 00) for the 987.1, due every 36,000 mi / 3 years (36k/72k/108k/144k mi; 3/6/9/12 yr). Includes everything in the minor service PLUS renewing the engine air-filter element, plus added chassis/driveline checks: fuel lines, parking-brake free play, clutch pedal play & end position, steering-gear and axle-joint / tie-rod / drive-shaft dust boots, exhaust system, seat belts, and all rubber/hydraulic running-gear mounts. On the 987.2 (2009-2012) the equivalent is the 'Maintenance' operation (LO 03 16 00) performed every 40,000 mi / 4 years alongside the annual oil change.
source: Porsche PNA 000 162 EE — 987/997 Major Maintenance Checklist (LO 03 26 00, Edition 11/07); 987.2 per PNA 000 162 EH (2009)

notes: Boxster only (Labor Operation 03 70 00) - clean, lubricate and care for the convertible-top mechanism and seals. The 2009 987.2 schedule (PNA 000 162 EH) lists 20,000 mi / 2 years; the earlier 2008 987.1 checklists list 12,000 mi / 1 year. Not applicable to the Cayman (fixed roof).
source: Porsche PNA 000 162 EH (2009, 20k/2yr) and PNA 000 162 EC (2008, 12k/1yr) — 987/997 maintenance checklists

notes: For cars with the Tire Pressure Monitoring option: the in-wheel TPM sensors run on non-replaceable batteries. Porsche schedules a first check after 4 years, then every 2 years thereafter (time-based only). A depleted sensor must be replaced as a unit. Applies to all 987 so equipped.
source: Porsche PNA 000 162 EH (2009) / EC / EE — 987/997 maintenance checklists

notes: Porsche schedules an airbag / restraint-system inspection after 4 years, again at 8 and 10 years, then every 2 years thereafter. Time-based only (no mileage trigger). Applies to all 987.1 and 987.2.
source: Porsche PNA 000 162 EH (2009) / EC / EE — 987/997 maintenance checklists

notes: Boxster (Cabriolet) only - the pop-up roll-over bars behind the seats are function-checked every 2 years, performed together with the biennial brake-fluid change. Not applicable to the Cayman.
source: Porsche PNA 000 162 EH (2009) / EC / EE — 987/997 maintenance checklists

notes: Visual inspection of the exhaust system for leaks and damage, and of its mounting and heat shields - performed at each major service (36k mi/3yr on the 987.1; part of the 40k/4yr Maintenance on the 987.2). All 987 years.
source: Porsche PNA 000 162 EE — 987/997 Major Maintenance Checklist (LO 03 26 00, Edition 11/07)

notes: Major-service chassis check: axle-joint and tie-rod play plus dust boots, drive-shaft CV boots, security of the front/rear running-gear (alignment) adjustment fasteners, and a visual inspection of all rubber/hydraulic assembly & running-gear mounts for damage. Every 36k mi/3yr on the 987.1 (part of the 40k/4yr Maintenance on the 987.2). All 987 years.
source: Porsche PNA 000 162 EE — 987/997 Major Maintenance Checklist (LO 03 26 00, Edition 11/07)

task: Steering gear inspection & power-steering fluid check
notes: Visual inspection of the steering-gear dust boots for damage plus a power-steering fluid-level check (the 987 uses HYDRAULIC steering with CHF 11S/202, unlike the electric-assist 981). Done at the major service (36k mi/3yr on the 987.1; part of the 40k/4yr Maintenance on the 987.2). All 987 years.
source: Porsche PNA 000 162 EE — 987/997 Major Maintenance Checklist (Edition 11/07); Porsche GB Boxster Service Manual
